items.title: LLM-RAG System for Disaster Mitigation
items.desc: Contributed to the development of an LLM-RAG system for disaster mitigation by providing fine-tuned Whisper model for domain-specific speech recognition, achieving up to 2.5x improvement in Word Error Rate (WER) compared to the vanilla model. Also developed an audio-to-text data processing pipeline using YouTube videos and automated domain-relevant text filtration using LLMs through ChatGPT and Gemini APIs. Published model: octava/whisper-small-disaster on Hugging Face.
items.tags: Python, Whisper, Hugging Face, LLM, RAG, ChatGPT API, Gemini API

items.title: MinerbaOne: Indonesian Mineral and Coal Mining Governance Web App
items.desc: Designed and developed comprehensive Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD) by translating complex regulatory requirements and analyzing thousands of tables across multiple existing systems into scalable database models. Designed a dynamic data warehouse architecture to support historical data tracking and future analytical use cases, while optimizing ORM queries through refactoring into raw PostgreSQL queries.
items.tags: PostgreSQL, Database Design, Data Modeling, Data Warehouse, ERD, DBeaver, Laravel

items.title: Web-Based Sentiment Analysis Dashboard
items.desc: Developed and deployed a sentiment analysis model using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF), statistical feature engineering, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). Integrated the model into a web-based dashboard to provide intuitive sentiment analysis and data visualization. Research findings were presented at the 3ICT conference and published in IEEE proceedings.
items.tags: Python, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF, SVM, Machine Learning, Flask, ReactJS, ExpressJS, MySQL
